cases.title: Start within the latency target
cases.given: A supported desktop browser has microphone permission and no active session.
then: RecordingStartedEvent moves the banner to Recording.
A transcript segment is visible within 2 seconds of speech; measure actual mic-to-screen latency.

cases.title: Reject a second active recording
cases.given: The same user has an active recording in another tab.
then: Client disables start and Core atomically rejects a competing command with session_conflict.
The original recording remains the owner of the session.

cases.title: Repair only recoverable audio gaps
cases.given: Healthy OPFS has retained frames across a temporary browser-to-Core disconnect.
cases.when: Reconnect, inspect missing ranges and upload the missing chunks.
then: Missing frame ranges are deduplicated and verified using the documented checksums.
Core reports contiguous durable progress; only acknowledged local chunks are trimmed.
The composed source and final transcript include recovered audio.

cases.title: Audio capture survives ML degradation
cases.given: A recording has healthy cloud or local audio durability.
cases.when: Interrupt the ML connection while speaking.
then: An ml_unavailable health banner appears.
Audio capture continues while live insights pause.
Durable audio remains available for final rebuild.

cases.title: Expose loss of local durability
cases.given: OPFS is unavailable, full or has a corrupt local chunk.
cases.when: Continue recording or attempt gap recovery.
then: The UI reports the local-buffer health limitation.
Healthy direct transport may continue.
Unrecoverable gaps are visible; the UI does not promise unconditional losslessness.

cases.title: Upload and stop share finalization
cases.given: Durable uploaded audio or composed live audio is ready.
then: Batch transcription completes before synthesis starts.
Final transcript replaces live segments; headline, summary, topics and talking points are persisted.
Completion is observable through transcription status and survives refresh.

cases.title: Preserve private notes through rebuild
cases.given: The user has typed and autosaved private notes during recording.
then: The last successfully saved notes are restored.
Final synthesis leaves user notes unchanged.
Save failure is visible and does not corrupt previously saved content.

cases.title: Protect user ownership during task reconciliation
cases.given: Live output includes unedited system tasks, a user-created task and a system task edited by the user.
cases.when: Write the final generated task replacement set.
then: User-created and user-edited tasks are preserved as source=user.
Unedited system tasks are replaced or removed according to the final set.
Deleted user-owned tasks do not silently reappear.

cases.title: Manual speaker labels win over matching
cases.given: A speaker has an automatic match or an exhausted match state.
cases.when: Assign that speaker to a person and reconnect ML.
then: Every segment for that speaker in the meeting reflects the selected person.
ML receives manual state and does not overwrite it with a voice match.

cases.title: Review transcript in sync with durable audio
cases.given: Composed audio and the final transcript are available.
cases.when: Play the audio, select a transcript segment and approach URL expiry.
then: Playback streams directly from GCS and highlights the matching segment.
Selecting a segment seeks to its start time.
The client refreshes the signed URL before expiry.

cases.title: Warn before the hard recording limit
cases.given: A recording approaches the configured maximum duration.
cases.when: Reach the warning threshold and then the hard limit.
then: Warn at T−10 minutes for the default four-hour limit.
Server auto-stop uses the normal drain, gap repair, compose and finalization path.

cases.title: Reuse context-linked note behavior
cases.given: The user visits /notes, meeting detail and person detail.
cases.when: Create, find, edit and delete a context-linked note on these surfaces.
then: The note composer and cards behave consistently.
Meeting and person contexts are prefilled and lists are correctly scoped.

cases.title: Recover after event replay expires
cases.given: The connection was absent longer than the five-minute replay window.
then: Discard the expired cursor and re-fetch current meeting and transcript state through REST.
Do not order replay using CloudEvent UUIDs.

cases.title: Avoid resurrecting a deleted meeting
cases.given: The meeting is soft-deleted while final processing is running.
cases.when: ML writes final synthesis and task results.
then: Documented write-backs return success without writing replacement artefacts.
The deleted meeting is not recreated by background work.

cases.title: M05 · test_app_opfs_worker_buffers_all_audio_chunks

then: Start recording, produce 20 mock audio chunks. Verify the OPFS worker's manifest reports chunkCount: 20 and lastSequence: 20.

cases.title: M05 · test_app_opfs_buffer_continues_during_ws_disconnect
cases.given: The prerequisites of slice-app-recording-durability-ui are satisfied in the test_app test environment.
then: Start recording, disconnect the WebSocket after 10 chunks, produce 10 more chunks while disconnected. Verify OPFS manifest reports chunkCount: 20 — all chunks buffered regardless of WS state.

cases.title: M05 · test_app_opfs_trims_on_audio_stored_progress
cases.given: The prerequisites of slice-app-recording-durability-ui are satisfied in the test_app test environment.
then: Start recording, produce 30 chunks. Emit AudioStoredProgressEvent with highest_contiguous_sequence: 20. Verify the OPFS worker's manifest reports chunks only for sequences > 20.

cases.title: M05 · test_app_trims_opfs_on_gap_upload_complete
cases.given: The prerequisites of slice-app-recording-durability-ui are satisfied in the test_app test environment.
then: Start recording, produce 50 chunks, simulate a gap. Emit GapUploadCompleteEvent with highest_contiguous_sequence: 50 and remaining_missing_ranges: []. Verify the OPFS worker deletes all chunks ≤ 50 and the manifest reports chunkCount: 0.

cases.title: M05 · test_app_uploads_gap_chunks_on_reconnect
cases.given: The prerequisites of slice-app-recording-durability-ui are satisfied in the test_app test environment.
then: Start recording, produce 20 chunks, disconnect WS, produce 10 more chunks (seq 21–30), reconnect. Verify ResumeRecordingCommand sent. On RecordingResumedEvent with missing_ranges: [{start: 21, end: 30}], verify the app uploads chunks 21–30 via POST /chunks.

cases.title: M05 · test_app_sends_resume_command_with_opfs_sequence
cases.given: The prerequisites of slice-app-recording-durability-ui are satisfied in the test_app test environment.
then: Start recording, produce 30 chunks, disconnect WS. On reconnect, verify ResumeRecordingCommand is sent with last_client_sequence: 30 (the value from the OPFS worker's manifest lastSequence).

cases.title: M05 · test_app_uploads_gap_chunks_on_stop
cases.given: The prerequisites of slice-app-recording-durability-ui are satisfied in the test_app test environment.
then: Stop recording. On RecordingStoppedEvent with missing_ranges: [{start: 35, end: 40}], verify the app reads those sequences from OPFS and uploads via POST /chunks.

cases.title: M05 · test_app_skips_corrupt_opfs_chunks_during_gap_upload
cases.given: The prerequisites of slice-app-recording-durability-ui are satisfied in the test_app test environment.
then: Corrupt an OPFS chunk's CRC32C. During gap upload, verify the corrupt chunk is skipped, the upload proceeds with valid chunks, and a local_buffer_corrupt_chunk warning is surfaced.

cases.title: M05 · test_app_resumes_gap_upload_after_page_reload
cases.given: The prerequisites of slice-app-recording-durability-ui are satisfied in the test_app test environment.
then: Simulate a stopped recording with remaining gaps (missing_ranges: [{start: 45, end: 50}]). "Close" the page, "reopen" it. Verify the app calls GET /meetings/{id}/recording/missing-chunks, reads the OPFS buffer, and resumes uploading gap chunks.

cases.title: M05 · test_app_shows_reconnecting_banner_on_ws_disconnect

cases.title: M05 · test_app_shows_critical_banner_on_local_buffer_failure

cases.title: M05 · test_app_renders_gap_upload_progress

cases.title: M05 · test_core_gap_upload_rejects_checksum_mismatch

cases.title: M05 · test_core_gap_upload_rejects_after_composition

cases.title: M05 · test_core_emits_gap_upload_complete_event

then: After creating a gap (sequences 11–14 missing), upload those chunks via POST /chunks. Verify the browser WebSocket receives GapUploadCompleteEvent with updated highest_contiguous_sequence and remaining_missing_ranges: [].
